name: lgetxattr
synopsis: ssize_t lgetxattr(const char *path, const char *name, void *value, size_t size);
description: lgetxattr retrieves the value of an extended attribute associated with the specified path. For symbolic links, it interrogates the link itself rather than the target file. It is similar to getxattr but specifically handles symbolic links differently.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the file or symbolic link

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Buffer to store the attribute value

return_value.success: Returns the size in bytes of the extended attribute value
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The size of the attribute value is larger than the maximum size allowed
The named attribute does not exist, or the process has no access
Extended attributes are not supported by the filesystem
The size of the value buffer is too small to hold the result
